note: Family-run campground on 120 acres of farmland and bottomland woods on the Kankakee River 1.5 miles east of Momence, in business since 1965. Many sites are seasonal; the nightly sites are mostly in the open meadow on the west loop. Swimming pond, half a mile of river frontage with a concrete boat ramp, recreation hall. --Claude

Fees 50/52 confirmed for 2026 (manual); booking phone (manual, deposit); season 4/15-10/15, hookups 50A + water (manual); showers + dump added. flags: PRICE GATE: base $50 (30-amp) is AT the gate, not over; 50-amp is $52. gateways.py: none within 40 km (Indiana Dunes NP 71 km). Good Sam not checked as a rescue since the base passes. 4% credit card fee is extra.

LONG-STAY: nightly share roughly 40% on Esri imagery. The pond loops hold ~16-18 trailers with decks and sheds (seasonal look); the west-loop meadow shows ~10-12 grass pads standing empty in the autumn image (transient look). Rates page sells monthly 'Full-time occupancy' and a $1910 seasonal with winter storage. No wording discourages nightly guests: home page 'sites available nightly through seasonal stays'; the rates page asks for a reservation ('We're less likely to be able to host camping without a reservation.'). Google 4.8 stars, 86 reviews. Keep with the long-term caveat (in the note).

WATERFRONT: not waterfront KEPT. The river frontage is the boat-ramp road at the north edge (~41.1665,-87.6245), ~500 m from the camping loops through bottomland woods; the operator's map draws no sites on it.
PIN (optional, under 250 m): stored 41.16202,-87.62617 sits on the pond loop; Google's place point 41.160968,-87.627557 (office) is ~165 m SW. Either is inside the campground.
